messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, Infrastructure, Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Tarka Associates Team,

Your executive-search work across energy, infrastructure, engineering and major projects in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain and Qatar aligns closely with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where major projects require strong institutional relationships, regulatory coordination and responsible development. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
